headline: DMV Fantasy: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: DMV Fantasy is projected #10 of 16 with a 581.80 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Jayden Daniels, Breece Hall, and George Kittle. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.

projected_power.method: Sum of the eight verified projected starters' C-AVI values from all 16 AVI-Core team files

dynasty_power.method: Sum of every verified rostered player's D-AVI value from all 16 AVI-Core team files

latest_trade.summary: On July 24, DMV Fantasy traded with Big Balder Brand and acquired Breece Hall while sending Cam Little, Saquon Barkley. Breece Hall is now the current RB starter at 87.7 C-AVI and 85.7 D-AVI.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the FLEX slot above Rachaad White's 55.6 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 88.6 C-AVI would directly attack the 33.00-point projected gap to Badland Banditos.
